style_guide.voice: lowercase casual, no periods at end of posts, no emojis, no em dashes, metrics-forward with specific numbers, questions to drive replies, founder voice with 20+ years paid media experience, pro-agency, algorithm-optimized for reply engagement and dwell time
style_guide.avoid: corporate speak, AI-powered, emojis, em dashes, engagement bait, external links in posts, vague value props without numbers, listicle-style bullet dumps, one-liners
style_guide.positioning: synter is competitive intelligence for marketing agencies. ad spend data, keyword gaps, tech stack analysis, competitor overlap, ad creative history. agencies use it to win pitches and prep for client calls. joel has 20+ years in paid media and built synter because he lived the problem

thread:
the feature that almost killed our API budget

launched bulk domain analysis: upload 50 prospect domains, get competitive intel on all of them

one agency uploaded 200 domains on day one. our spyfu API bill for that single day: $47

our monthly API budget was $200

had to implement smart caching immediately. repeat analyses within 7 days hit cache. API costs dropped 64%

current unit economics: $0.12 per domain analysis after caching. at $49/user/mo we need users analyzing fewer than 408 domains/mo to stay profitable

average user analyzes 31 domains/mo. we're fine. but that one agency with 200 domains taught us to plan for power users

what's the most expensive lesson you learned from shipping fast

week_2.text:

the bug: timestamps stored in UTC, compared against pacific time. every domain looked checked "3 hours ago"
